claim: Measure the original's frames-per-update distribution before choosing a pace; where slowdown is dropped, a steady frame count can be agreed.

evidence.text: Recording averages 4.35 frames per update (28% 3, 34% 4, 22% 5); title alternates 2 and 3; at 28 MHz every update took 3 (45% fast), so PACE 4 and the owner dropped slowdown.
